page_text_ocr_zh:
吹口哨的风
chuī kǒu shào de fēng
page_text_en:
The Whistling Wind
chuī kǒu shào de fēng
summary_zh: 本页展示了绘本的标题页，标题为《吹口哨的风》，背景为橙色，文字竖排居中。

page_text_ocr_zh:
鼹鼠先生要过生日了。他写了一张请帖，请风先生给他的好朋友小松鼠送去。

风拿着请帖，一路上吹着口哨，跑啊跑啊，跑到山坡边上。远处的杜鹃花开了，风把请帖朝路边随手一丢，

去找花儿们玩去了。

一只老狼捡到了请帖，他来赴宴。要不是鼹鼠先生逃得快，他就会成为狼的一道点心。

鼹鼠先生重新写了一张请帖，请风先生帮着送去。

风拿着请帖，一路上吹着口哨，跑啊跑啊，跑到小路边上，他看到路边
page_text_en:
Mr. Mole was having a birthday. He wrote an invitation and asked Mr. Wind to deliver it to his good friend, little squirrel.

Wind held the invitation, whistling all the way, running and running, until he reached the hillside. The azaleas were blooming in the distance, so Wind casually tossed the invitation onto the roadside,

and went off to play with the flowers.

A wolf found the invitation and came to the party. If Mr. Mole hadn't run away quickly, he would have become the wolf's dinner.

Mr. Mole wrote a new invitation and asked Mr. Wind to deliver it again.

Wind held the invitation, whistling all the way, running and running, until he reached the roadside, where he saw
summary_zh: 本页讲述了鼹鼠先生请风先生帮忙送生日请帖给小松鼠，风先生途中随手丢弃请帖去找花儿玩，结果被狼捡到，险些酿成悲剧。鼹鼠先生只好重新写请帖，风先生再次出发送信，途中又看到路边景象。

page_text_ocr_zh:
的树丛里有两只小獾在打架，就把请帖随便一丢，钻进树丛里看热闹去了。

一只狐狸捡到了请帖，他倚在一棵树上读了起来，当他知道这是小鼹鼠的请帖时，高兴得手舞足蹈，说：“能吃上一只鼹鼠也是不错的！”
他这话说得太响了，被树上的小松鼠听到了。

小松鼠赶快抄小路连奔带跑地赶到鼹鼠家里，鼹鼠正开着门在等小松鼠呢。小松鼠一进屋，小鼹鼠就关紧了门，他们在屋里欢庆生日，把随后赶来的狐狸关在门外。

不过，打这以后，谁也不想请风先生送请帖了。

因为，风先生太不守信用了。
page_text_en:
In the bushes, two little badgers were fighting, so he casually tossed the invitation away and crawled into the bushes to watch the commotion.

A fox found the invitation. He leaned against a tree and read it. When he realized it was an invitation to a mole's party, he danced with joy and said, "It would be great to eat a mole!"
He spoke so loudly that the little squirrel in the tree heard him.

The squirrel hurriedly took a shortcut, running and rushing to the mole's house. The mole was waiting at the open door for the squirrel. As soon as the squirrel entered, the mole quickly shut the door. They celebrated the birthday inside, leaving the fox locked out.

However, after this, no one wanted to ask Mr. Wind to deliver invitations anymore.

Because Mr. Wind was too untrustworthy.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了狐狸捡到鼹鼠的生日请帖后想吃掉鼹鼠，被树上的小松鼠听到，小松鼠赶去通知鼹鼠，最终将狐狸关在门外。事件后，大家都不再想请风先生送请帖，因为他太不守信用。
